newsitem.title: USA: USDA Acting Under Sec for Food, Nutrition named.
newsitem.headline: USDA Acting Under Sec for Food, Nutrition named.

text.p: The Agriculture Department announced on Tuesday that Mary Ann Keeffe has been named to serve as Acting Under Secretary for Food, Nutrition and Consumer Services.
Keeffe, who as served as deputy of the division since last March, will serve as head of the branch under a successor to Under Secretary Ellen Haas, who resigned effective February 14, is confirmed.
USDA's Food, Nutrition and Consumer Services is responsible for implementing the department's 15 food assistance programs, the biggest among these the Food Stamp Program.
